field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable NetBird

field.label: WireGuard Port
field.help: WireGuard interface listening port (use 0 for automatic port selection)

field.label: Interface Name
field.help: Name of the WireGuard tunnel interface created by NetBird (default wt0)

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) for the WireGuard interface (default 1280, valid range 576-8192)

field.label: Hostname Override
field.help: Override the system hostname reported to the NetBird management server

field.label: Force IP Mapping
field.help: Map external IPv4 addresses to local addresses or interfaces for NAT traversal. Specify a comma-separated list of external IPs (e.g. 12.34.56.78), external/local IP pairs (12.34.56.78/10.0.0.1), or external IP/interface pairs (12.34.56.78/em1). Leave empty to discover external IPs automatically via STUN.

field.label: Interface Blacklist
field.help: Select OPNsense interfaces to exclude from NetBird ICE candidate gathering and route monitoring

field.label: Network Monitor
field.help: Monitor network changes and reconnect automatically when interfaces or routes change

field.label: Disable Auto-Connect
field.help: Do not connect automatically when the NetBird service starts

field.label: Force Relay
field.help: Force all peer connections through relay servers instead of direct P2P connections (for troubleshooting)

field.label: Traffic Handling
field.help: Select how NetBird handles traffic filtering and forwarding. NetBird mode uses NetBird's userspace filter and forwarder. OPNsense mode turns off NetBird's firewall and server routes so packets go to the kernel and are handled by pf and outbound NAT.

field.label: Access LAN
field.help: Allow access to local networks (LAN) when using this peer as a routing peer or exit-node

field.label: Accept Client Routes
field.help: Accept and process client routes received from the management server. Warning: routes from the management server, including exit-node routes (0.0.0.0/0), go directly into OPNsense's routing table.

field.label: Enable Host DNS Management
field.help: Allow the client to manage host DNS. Warning: NetBird's changes to resolv.conf conflict with OPNsense managing that file.

field.label: DNS Resolver Address
field.help: Custom IP:port address for NetBird's local DNS resolver (defaults to 127.0.0.1:5053 when Unbound forwarding is enabled)

field.label: Forward NetBird Domain in Unbound
field.help: Forward queries for the NetBird DNS domain in Unbound to NetBird's resolver address so LAN clients can resolve peer names

field.label: NetBird DNS Domain
field.help: DNS domain used by your NetBird network to forward to NetBird's resolver in Unbound

field.label: Enable
field.help: Allow incoming NetBird SSH connections

field.label: Enable Root Login
field.help: Allow root user login over NetBird SSH

field.label: Enable SFTP
field.help: Enable SFTP subsystem for file transfers

field.label: Enable Local Port Forwarding
field.help: Allow clients to forward local ports through the server. Warning: forwarded connections come from the firewall itself, so they can bypass pf.

field.label: Enable Remote Port Forwarding
field.help: Allow clients to request remote port forwarding. Warning: forwarded connections come from the firewall itself, so they can bypass pf.

field.label: Enable Rosenpass
field.help: Deprecated by NetBird, may be removed in a future release; not recommended for new setups.

field.label: Rosenpass Permissive Mode
field.help: Deprecated by NetBird, may be removed in a future release; not recommended for new setups.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Set the syslog logging level. Setting a certain log level will cause all messages of the specified and more severe log levels to be logged.
